name: DropTheHassle
description: Your AI puts your site live on a free HTTPS link, or on a .com for €19/$19 that goes live with no DNS after the human pays a link, with an optional real mailbox on the domain. Also checks domain availability and prices. No tool spends money; purchases return a payment link for the human. deploy_site and search_domain work without an account; account tools need a DropTheHassle token as a Bearer header.
author: DropTheHassle
